description: This Java class implements the command handling strategy for deleting attributes within a Thing entity in the Eclipse Ditto framework. It processes 'DeleteAttribute' commands by removing specified attributes from the entity, generating appropriate event and result responses.

classes.name: DeleteAttributeStrategy
classes.description: A final class that extends AbstractThingCommandStrategy to provide specific logic for handling DeleteAttribute commands, including applying deletions and generating corresponding events.

methods.name: doApply
methods.description: Executes the deletion of the specified attribute in the given Thing, returning a Result containing a ThingEvent or an error.

methods.name: getDeleteAttributeResult
methods.description: Constructs the result after successfully deleting an attribute, including creating an AttributeDeleted event and response.

methods.name: previousEntityTag
methods.description: Returns the EntityTag representing the previous state of the attribute before deletion.

methods.name: nextEntityTag
methods.description: Returns an empty Optional, as there is no next EntityTag after deletion.
